content: Jerusalén-gannar-neggweburga-sigoed
Amba Jeremías reyneg-imbagi esgaryagi-gales-mellesiidgi ilabogine Bab-Jehová-gayaburba ese nonibalid, ega weyob sognonikid:
“Ani an Bab-Jehová, napneg-obinnisad, napneg-nasiksad, innikigwadba napneg-ilemaksad, degi, Bab-Jehováʼye-an-nugad, soged:
‘Anse be gole, ani an be-abinsaoed, igar-dummagan-mamaid an bega sogoed, degi, ibmar-dukuar-mamaid an bega odalogoed. We-ibmarmar amba be wissulid.’
”Ani an Israel-dulemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, we-neggwebur-negmar-annik soged, degi, Judá-reymar-neg-ayaroed-annik soged:

‘Babilonia-dulemar, neggweburgi gwichiguega danikid, degi, neggweburgi dule-muimar-enogega danikid. An-urwedgine, degi, an-sae-itogedgine, Jerusalén-neggwebur-idu wagar-biir an imaksad. Bela e-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-ular, an ogilogoed.’
”Degi-inigwele, an bemar-bendakoed, degi, an bemar-nudakoed, degine, gannarse san-nued an bemar-imakoed. Yeer-bogidik-itodigumalaga, degi, dobedsuli-gudigumalaga an bemar-imakoed.
Gannar Israel-dulemar, degi, Judá-dulemar galesbukmaladgi an sedagoed. Gannar iduale-bukwagusadyobi an urbebaloed.
”Angi-isgusmalad an ega swilidik saoed. Angi-gwisgusmalad, angi gwisgussulidyob an dakoed.

Jerusalén-neggwebur weligwaledga anga guoed, degi, an-nug-ogannogega, degine, dulemar-neggwebur-akar-akar-bukwad-asabin an-nug-odummogega anga guoed. An Jerusalén-dulemarga ibmar-nuegan-saoedi, bela wisgumaloed, degi, an ega ibmar-nasgumai-imakoedi, bela wisgumarbaloed, degidbali, dobedba wawanmakdemaloed.”

Bab-Jehová soged: “Bemar sogmalad: ‘We-yala unnila olloo-selenaiye, dulemar sateye, degi, ibmar-durgan satebarye. Judá-neggweburmar, degi, Jerusalén-neg-galimbamar ollo-ollo-mamaiye, dulemar-sateye, degine, ibmar-durgan surbarye.’ Emide, gannar agine dule-sunmaked itoledagoed.

Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: Weligwaledba-binnasuli-goledi, yeer-itogedba binnasuli-goledi, degine, abirgin-nikuedgi-namaklegedi, gannar itoledagoed. Degi, dule an-itoged-negse anga ibmar-uknadapir weyob namaknadapi-gumaloedi, itolebaloed:

content.text: Ani an, we-dulemar gales-bukwadgi gannar sedagoed.

content: Weyob Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad soged: “We-neggwebur bela bibichis-siid, neggweburgi dulemar sated, degi, ibmar-durgan satebalid. Degi-inigwele, bela we-neggweburmargi gagan-araramalad nikuoed, agine dule moli-edarbemalad, e-molimar-obunnogega imakoed.
Ani an Bab-Jehová soged, wemar-neggweburmargi sibad-wawaadmar ebisnai gumaloed:
”Ani an Bab-Jehová soged: Ibagan nonikoed, Israel-dulemarga an ibmar-sogsadi, degi, Judá-dulemarga an ibmar-sogsadi, an ega sogedba imakoed.

content.text: A-ibagan-mosale, a-ibagine, David-wagwa reyga-megega an imakoed.

content: Aga Bab-Jehová weyob soged: “David-wagan, Israel-dulemar-e-reyga gusuli guosulid, nikagu guoed.
Degi, dule-irwa-anse-gormalad-Leví-wagan gwen surguosurmarmogad. An-asabinni, anga-ibmar-uklegedi, anga-ibmar-gwag-ogumakar-uklegedi, degi, bane-bane anga-ibmar-ogumakar-uklegedi, ukdigu gumaloed.”
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonibalid, ega weyob sognonikid:
“Ar bemar ibginedbo an-igar-mesisad be nabir bisgemalale, adi, melle neg-ibgined-naguega, degi, mutikidbo an igar mesisad be nabir bisgemarbalile, adi, melle mutikid-naguega,

sunna nabir an-mai-Davidʼbo an-igar-maid be osulosmarbaliled. Adi, melle e-wagan e-sorba reyga megegar. Degine, sunna nabir deyopira be dule-irwa-anse-gormalad-Leví-wagan, degi, Leví-wagan-baigan anga-arbamaladi, be osulosmarbaliled.

”Ani an, an-mai-David-wagan omelogoed, degi, deyob an Leví-wagan anga-arbamaladi, an omelobaloed. Niisgwamar nibneggi-nanaid-mergueyobi, an saoed, degi, demar-gakaba ukub-naid-mergueyobi, an imakoed.”
Jeremíasʼse Bab-Jehová-gayaburba nonikid, ega weyob sognonikid:
“¿Ar be daksursi, dulemarde an-annik-sogmalad, ande yala-sogabo-susadi bela obachaye? A-ulale, wede isdar-an-dulamar-dakmalad, dulamar-bukwasuliyob dakmalad.
Ani Bab-Jehová soged: An-sunnad an neg-ibginedbo-igar-mesissulina, degi, mutikidbo-igar-mesissulina, degine, nibneggad-igar-mamaid, napneggad-igar-mamaidi, an mesissurbalina,

an Jacob-wagan obachanad, degi, an-mai-David-wagan an obachabalinad. Degine, David-wagan, Abraham-waganga, Isaac-waganga, degi, Jacob-waganga, dummadga-negsemaiguega an sussulinad. Emide, an Israel-dulemar gannar e-yarse an sedagoed, an-dulamar an ise-wile dakoed.”
